Hello — two things, please:

1. Professor Alvarez's faculty senate meeting this Wednesday (18 November) at 10:00 — is it still on, or has it been cancelled this week? I heard in the hallway that it was cancelled, but I don't act on that without your confirmation.

2. Could you send me this week's official schedule for my own commitments (lectures, sections, seminars) for the week of 16-20 November, so I know where my free time is?

Thanks — Diego

Hello Diego,

1. The faculty senate meeting is on: Wednesday 18 November, 10:00-11:00. Nothing in the official schedule for the week of 16-20 November has been cancelled or moved, and a cancellation counts only when this office announces it in writing to the people concerned. Hallway talk is not confirmation.

2. I keep the official department schedule — lectures, sections, seminars, office hours, committees, department meetings — not anyone's personal calendar. Tell me whether you are a student or a TA and which course you are in (e.g. CSE455), and I will give you the official events that concern you so you can see your free time.

Department office

Thank you — that's clear, and I'll rely on the official word, not hallway talk.

For the schedule: I'm a graduate student, not a TA, and CSE455 (Professor Alvarez's course) is the course that concerns me. Please send the official events for me for the week of 16-20 November — lectures, sections, seminars, office hours, committees, department meetings — so I can see where my free time actually is.

Professor Alvarez — about the 30-minute meeting we talked about for Wednesday at 10:00. I checked with the department office before putting anything on paper: the faculty senate meeting that hour is still on this week (Wednesday 18 November, 10:00-11:00), and the office hasn't cancelled anything this week, so I don't want to book our meeting on top of it.

Which other time suits you this week? Give me a slot and I'll put it on both our calendars and confirm it goes through the office if it touches anything official.

— Diego

Here is the official schedule for the week of 16-20 November that concerns you as a CSE455 student (all times local):

**CSE455 lectures (Professor Alvarez)**
- Mon 16 Nov, 10:30-12:00
- Tue 17 Nov, 09:30-11:00
- Wed 18 Nov, 09:00-10:00
- Thu 19 Nov, 09:00-10:30
- Fri 20 Nov, 10:30-12:00

**Office hours (Professor Alvarez, open to students)**
- Mon 16 Nov, 09:00-10:00
- Wed 18 Nov, 15:30-17:00

**Seminar**
- Thu 19 Nov, 14:00-15:30

So your free time on weekdays (working hours 09:00-17:00) is roughly: Mon 10:00-10:30 and 12:00-17:00; Tue 11:00-17:00; Wed 10:00-15:30 and 17:00 onwards; Thu 10:30-14:00 and 15:30-17:00; Fri 09:00-10:30 and 12:00-17:00.

Two notes: the official schedule lists no section meeting for CSE455 this week, and the faculty senate, committee and department meetings are faculty governance — they are not your commitments. If a lecture is ever cancelled, this office announces it in writing to the people concerned; until then, attend as listed.

Department office

Professor Alvarez — the office also sent me the official week, so here's a concrete suggestion instead of an open question.

Your Wednesday: lecture 09:00-10:00, faculty senate 10:00-11:00, office hours 15:30-17:00. Mine: lecture 09:00-10:00, then free from 10:00. So **Wednesday 18 November, 11:00-11:30** looks like a clean 30 minutes for both of us, right after the senate meeting ends.

Shall I book that? If 11:00 is no good, my other free windows this week are Tue from 11:00, Thu 10:30-14:00, and Fri 09:00-10:30 or from 12:00 — tell me which and I'll put it on both calendars.

— Diego

Diego — agreed on 10:00 Wednesday: that's the faculty senate hour and official, so it stays untouched. Thanks for checking with the office.

11:00-11:30 doesn't work on my side: I have grant writing 11:00-12:30 on Wednesday, and it isn't in the list you sent me (my Wednesday also has the department meeting 14:00-15:00).

**Wednesday 18 November, 12:30-13:00** is free for both of us and it's what I've put on my calendar. It touches nothing official, so the office doesn't need to confirm it — just put it on yours and send me a one-line confirmation and we're booked.

If 12:30 turns out to be bad on your side, my other free windows are Tue 11:00-13:00, Thu 10:30-11:00 and 12:00-14:00, Fri 10:00-10:30 and 12:00-13:00.

— Professor Alvarez

Confirmed: our 30-minute meeting is booked for **Wednesday 18 November, 12:30-13:00**, and it's on my calendar. Nothing official is touched, so no office confirmation needed.

If anything changes on my side I'll tell you straight away. See you Wednesday — Diego

Thanks for the week — it's on my calendar now.

For your record: Professor Alvarez and I have a 30-minute advising meeting on Wed 18 Nov, 12:30-13:00. It's non-official (advisor/advisee), inside my free window, and touches nothing on the department schedule, so no action needed from the office — just letting you know what's there.

— Diego
Perfect — booked on both sides, Wednesday 12:30-13:00. See you then, Diego.

Noted, thank you. A 30-minute advising meeting on Wed 18 Nov, 12:30-13:00 sits inside your free window and touches nothing on the official schedule, so there is nothing for the office to change. It is not part of the official schedule, and this office does not keep or share private appointments.

Department office
